sources.name: YouGov: What are the top domestic travel destinations for Americans in 2025
sources.method: Jan 2025 survey of US adults, share considering a visit in next 2-3 years. NYC 30%, Las Vegas 30% (Hawaii 30%, excluded as a state). Other cities only via subgroup splits, approx: Los Angeles ~21%, Nashville ~21%, Key West ~21%, San Diego ~20%, San Francisco ~19%, Seattle ~18%, Charleston ~17.5%; ordered approximately on those.

sources.name: YouGov: America's favorite city is Nashville (50 most populous cities, net favorability)

changes_vs_current: New topic. Raw average-position order (12 people sources): NYC, Las Vegas, SF, Miami, Boston, New Orleans, LA, Chicago, Nashville, Seattle, San Diego, Atlanta, Phoenix, Denver, Portland, Honolulu, Key West, DC, Dallas, Orlando, Charleston, Houston.

Orlando moved up from raw #20 to #10: gut-check top 12; #1 US city by total visitors, #2 in Expedia flight bookings, #4 in overseas visitors. It ranks low only because it is absent from favorability polls, which do not rank it lower.
Washington DC moved up from raw #18 to #12: gut-check top 12; #7 in overseas visitors, top 10 in both Tripadvisor years. Only the 2012 PPP favorability poll (#17, partisan) ranks it low.

Los Angeles moved up from raw #7 to #3: gut-check #3; #2 in Ipsos open-ended, #3 in overseas visitors and Expedia flights, #3 among cities in YouGov 2025 visit intent. Partisan favorability (PPP #19) drags its average down.
Chicago moved up slightly from raw #8 to #5: gut-check #5, Conde Nast reader #1, Tripadvisor #6-#8, Ipsos #5.
Boston moved down from raw #5 to #9, and Miami from #4 to #7, to make room for the gut-check moves. Both stay in the top 10.
Honolulu stands in for Tripadvisor's 'Oahu'. Hawaii as a state is excluded per topic rules.
Key West stands in for Tripadvisor's 'Florida Keys' (2025) and YouGov's Key West.
Austin, Savannah and Colorado Springs are left off. Each has only one favorability-type source. San Antonio takes #24, backed by Stacker/YouGov (#8) and YouGov's 50-city favorability (top 8).
confidence: medium: the top 2 (NYC, Las Vegas) are solid across every source, but no single open-ended 'favorite city to visit' poll with a full list exists, so the order from #3 to #12 blends visit-intent, visitor counts and favorability with gut-check adjustments.
